prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Post-adoption/certificate sign-in timing, account recovery copy, and multi-device sync banners won, while moving sign-in post-waiting hurt and sync hints/notices showed no clear effect.
Headline clarity updates, spotlight layouts, and story stage visual redesigns won; checklist layouts and story scroll redesigns hurt, while value refreshes and copy simplifications showed no clear effect.
Interactive waiting rooms, readiness/visibility status checks, and desktop spawn hints won; 3D trackers, completion timers, progress indicators, and sound notifications showed no clear effect.
Split upload companion previews paired with photo quality guides won; compact grids, multi-step quality inspection/fallback flows, guidelines banners, and stamp redesigns hurt, while pre-adoption reviews showed no clear effect.
Interactive spawn placement flows, desktop placement verification screens, and system tray location tips won; direct controls guides and first interaction tips hurt, while welcome stage redesigns and retrieval callouts had no clear effect.
Predictions underpredicted counter-intuitive wins (e.g., placement verification screens, interactive spawn flows) and overpredicted outcomes on severe failures (e.g., stamp redesigns, direct controls guides, multi-step quality inspection flows).

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In Post-Adoption Certificate Step: Reorder the sign-in screen to take place immediately after the adoption certificate stage rather than before photo upload. (why: Adoption has a steep drop-off at 68.9%. Asking users to sign in after they have named and certified their companion captures post-creation momentum.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Photo Quality Verification Stage Screen: Add a dedicated photo clarity verification screen between upload photos and adoption certificate to validate image rendering before pet creation. (why: Support receives multiple bug reports about custom pets failing or rendering incorrectly, causing abandonment during adoption (68.9% conversion).)
2: [home, redesign] Interactive Hatching Chamber Waiting Redesign: Redesign the waiting screen into a split layout interactive hatching chamber with real-time progress indicators. (why: The waiting phase has an extreme mean duration of 2336s (median 201s), leading to user drop-off before reaching home.)
3: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Companion Spawn Guided Stage: Transform the home intro screen into a stage-based onboarding flow that guides users step-by-step on how to locate, spawn, and control their desktop pet. (why: Support received multiple tickets regarding pet visibility issues and confusion around controlling or hiding the desktop pet after onboarding.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Hatch Ready System Notification Prompt: Enable system readiness notifications on the waiting screen so users get notified when background rendering finishes. (why: Waiting median duration is 201s (mean 2336s), causing users to switch windows and forget to return.)
5: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Badge Reward: Add an official guardian badge component to the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption drop-off is the largest drop point in the funnel (68.9% conversion); adding a reward component increases delight and completion momentum.)
6: [home, wait_info] Background Pet Preparation Readiness Time Indicator: Display active progress bars and estimated completion timer on the waiting room screen. (why: Users wait an average of 2336s on the waiting screen; visual readiness indicators reduce perceived wait time and bounce rates.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Story Welcome Two Column Layout: Change the initial story intro screen to a two-column layout highlighting companion choices and setup overview side-by-side. (why: High mean time spent on choose_path/story (514s) indicates early engagement needs clearer structure.)

scores.note: Post-adoption certificate sign-in timing was a proven winner, and sign_in reorder has a historical +3.1% lift.

Supported by both funnel drop-off and support tickets; interactive spawn placement flows won in historical lessons with +6.2% lift.
